reporting.primary_denominator: Original admitted per-variant source-native critical+noncritical requirements frozen before D
reporting.excluded_original_quantitative_targets: Separate exclusion counts with evidence and cause; never numerator or implicit FULL
reporting.macro_and_micro: Report across admitted model variants, with shared obligation allocation disclosed, plus declared vs eligible vs attempted denominators
reporting.scope: Purposefully selected source-conditional corpus; no population representativeness, no universal minimality proof

evidence_classes.FULL: All applicable witnessed source-defined critical and noncritical required distinctions preserved; no conflicting extra assumptions; source-grounded semantic/mechanistic fidelity verified within admitted source scope; mere syntactic mapping insufficient
evidence_classes.PARTIAL: Some faithful evidence but documented nonfatal source-required gaps or extra assumptions; exact missing IDs and consequences
evidence_classes.FAILED: Admissible original source, fair trial and documented essential loss/contradiction; never infer from inaccessible source
evidence_classes.INPUT_UNDERSPECIFIED: Critical primary or packet missing/invalid/unreadable, unadmitted edition or broken evidence chain; quarantined from fidelity inference
evidence_classes.UNDERDETERMINED: Eligible original but unresolved material original ambiguity/reference disagreement/multiple nonresolvable interpretations after bounded review
evidence_classes.NOT_ATTEMPTED: Administrative ledger state outside five scientific classifications

coordination.A0: All original states, source-defined coordinators, controls and properly typed existing connections; no reconstructed additional operations
coordination.A1: A0 plus explicit typed current-input-only, no hidden history stateless adapter; requires source-native type contrast and fair A0 failure
coordination.A2: A0/A1 plus explicitly source-warranted additional persistent typed state/init/update with independent observable contrast; fair exhaustion of all original state/control functions and A1
coordination.adverse_rule: A2 representation failure alone never H2
coordination.non_discriminating: If source-native contrast absent or original architecture already integrated, return NON_DISCRIMINATING, not assumed H0/H1/H2
coordination.high_risk: Novel H1/H2 requires targeted exception-only human route; independent empirical causal necessity requires separate primary evidence

SWAP_BOUNDARY.operation: Move required internal/external relation across boundary

REMOVE_NATIVE_COORDINATOR.operation: Suppress source-defined coordinator, not invent additional one

STATEFUL_TO_STATELESS.failure_detected: Same input distinct history witness lost

G_DYN.applicable: Frozen forgetful-map direct-preservation semantics supplies non-X/K/T witness
G_DYN.operation: Apply fixed weaker G_dyn={X,K,T} direct-preservation competitor
G_DYN.failure_detected: Source-required Pi/C/Q/P direction/rho distinctions explicitly forgotten or merged

control_verdicts.INFORMATIVE: Real source-witness-applicable destructive change valid and baseline positive, loss detected
control_verdicts.NON_DISCRIMINATING: Valid change without source-distinguishable contrast, not included in power denominator
control_verdicts.INVALID: No applicable source witness, invalid mutation, baseline underdetermined or invalid packet/source
control_verdicts.FALSE_POSITIVE_RECONSTRUCTION: Valid source-discriminable destructive modification nevertheless judged FULL; count detection failure

historical_comparison_immutability.maximal_common_images: Retain all distinct maximal non-dominated common images, including tied structurally distinct witnesses; no fixed archetype count
historical_comparison_immutability.before_unmask: Anonymous atlas+source-free structural comparator witnesses frozen at ATLAS0
historical_comparison_immutability.after_unmask: Curator label vault only after immutable ATLAS0 and authorized UNMASK; label correspondence exploratory

stage_chronology.required_RB0_sidecar: After R0 and before P0 and all analyst D; no R0/RB0 in preauthorization MAIN
stage_chronology.verification: qualify_g3_v11.py raw Git stage artifact and receipt-byte SHA chain, full Git ancestor verification for real scientific execution; signed author authority externally verified
